name: Sebastian Schaal
headline: ⚡ Intelligence for your electronics supply chain | Founder & Managing Director @ Luminovo
summary:
🧒 When I was a child, I wanted to be an inventor. Gyro Gearloose was my hero.

🎓 Eventually, I grew up and realized that inventor isn’t really a job title anymore. So I studied electrical engineering at TU Munich, earned a second Master’s degree in Management Science & Engineering at Stanford University, and completed the honors program at CDTM.

🤖 What stayed with me was a deep belief that technological innovation is the most powerful tool we have to solve humanity’s biggest challenges. So I asked myself: what if I could build something for the industry that is the pacemaker of technological progress?

⚡ That’s why Timon and I founded Luminovo. We are on a mission to bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by building a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

💡 In the end, I may not have become an inventor in the traditional sense, but I’ve built something that empowers thousands of inventors worldwide. I think Gyro would be proud.

positions.title: Founder & Managing Director
positions.description:
🔌 Electronic products power technological progress, from climate tech to the future of healthcare.
Yet complexity across electronics supply chains is rising every day.

🤯 Electronics procurement still runs one of the world’s most critical supply chains on Excel.
Mission-critical data lives in silos, leading to missed cost savings, slow decisions, and costly disruptions.

🔗 Luminovo builds intelligence systems for electronics supply chains.
We connect design, sourcing, and manufacturing data so teams can monitor, source, and quote PCBAs in one seamless digital flow.

🔢 The impact:
• ~10% cost savings
• up to 90% faster processes

🚀 Helping innovators bring products to market faster, cheaper, and more resiliently.

🙌 Sounds exciting? Message me directly here on LinkedIn.

company.name: Luminovo
company.description:
Luminovo is the electronics supply chain platform that helps you quote and procure faster and better by bringing all your data, processes, and players together in one place. Our products for OEM (Design-to-source) and for EMS (Configure-price-quote) are modular and easily tailored to your needs thanks to an array of add-ons specifically built for the electronics industry challenges. 

We are a mix of deep learning natives, business talents and product enthusiasts. Our current team not only includes top graduates from institutions such as Stanford University, Cambridge, ETH Zurich, TUM, and CDTM, but also motivated individuals with rather unconventional CVs who are burning for what they do. Luminovo was born in Munich but has evolved into a remote-first company operating globally and with our team spread from Amsterdam to Valencia, Tirana, and Nairobi. 🌍

If you're someone working in the electronics industry or looking to grow a software startup – join Luminovo as we pioneer a modern setup of the all-encompassing electronics industry. 🚀
